conditional_predictions.rationale: If trial content drives performance, shuffling labels within a subject should break the task mapping for each new label configuration, reducing BA to chance.

If identity effects drive performance, permuting labels while preserving class counts might still allow metadata-based prediction if identities are preserved; however, the tool permutes within subject so this is less clear. We expect near-zero gap as a baseline.

prediction.update_rule_if_opposite: If BA remains high after shuffling (positive direction), H2 gains support over H1 regarding identity effects persisting despite label permutation.
